items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: John Hammond was the instigator. He's the one that told me about it... John Hammond, he asked me would I like to join Raymond Scott up at CBS? ... John Hammond was also the instigator of me leaving CBS to join Carmen Jones.

ctx.x: Lou Shuby, he was the contractor for all of the bands at CBS. Of course John Hammond was the instigator. He's the one that told me about it.
